body: Round 1 (4a921414..bcbd6949), P0 high, class trust-boundary-pr-input (the fourth): item 2's 'checks against the claimed copy still run' fed the head copy to the base checker, whose C10 passes a backticked literal to git grep -qF unquoted; a literal --open-files-in-pager=CMD ran CMD in the pull_request_target job (reproduced with a marker). Adopted as a02 amendment 1 (807c6b74) and fixed in 1ee15af1: checker(root, data) runs the base checker only on the base's dispatched bytes; an unverifiable copy skips it with a warning; regression 56ccbee1 red at bcbd6949 (validation 4a), 357ff237.

Round 1, P2 high: the checker's C6 opened the design path the head copy named (an absolute path read outside the checkout and echoed into the log). Closed by the same rule (1ee15af1): the design path comes only from base text; the checker's own containment belongs to P1-12 (dotfiles-T133-task-generator-plan-check-a02).

Round 1, P3 high: a head-only successor's reset_of dropped a dispatched predecessor from the targets. Fixed in 1ee15af1: a chain counts only when both copies verify against the base; tests in 56ccbee1 and 357ff237 (both directions).

Round 1, P3 high: the precheck ancestor diff ran with rename detection, so a prechecked code file moved into the evidence directory hid its deletion. Fixed in 1ee15af1 (--no-renames); subtest 'precheck renamed' in 56ccbee1.

Round 1, P3 medium: touching an old dispatched task's directory makes its authenticated policy apply. Recorded as a residual in report.md before promotion (the check authenticates the policy text, not the task a PR belongs to).
Round 1, P3: the a02 evidence records were not on bcbd6949. Committed with this record.

Round 2 (bcbd6949..1ee15af1), same reviewer: Verdict: correct; the P0, the C6 read and both P3s are closed (its PoCs re-run), 20 of 21 mutants die. Its new P3: the base checker reads base dispatched texts from regime.yml's merge, not its promotion; no current exposure (514 texts scanned, no git-executable option literal). Recorded as a residual in report.md, with the P1-12 hardening to land before the merge as the orchestrator's ordering decision.
